verdict.rationale: Algolia documents official SDKs/API clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin, .NET, covered by an SLA, plus REST API docs and community corroboration (React InstantSearch praised as great DX, easy plugin integration). Additional agent-oriented tooling (CLI, MCP server, skills) further supports AI-native developer workflows. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking or hands-on verification of SDK completeness/quality across all listed languages beyond docs and anecdotal HN praise.
